items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Tom Saunders was in that band.

ctx.x: See, they used to advertise as the only living Cotton Pickers, which there was about three fellows still living. Yeah. And then somehow another, the band and Jim Taylor got into it. After Jim Taylor got a whipping, the band just dropped out. Now they got one or two fellows every year when the Montreux is there, they get up to slow five or six pieces and see the new McKinney Cotton Pickers and play one or two jobs with them. And then the fellows are scattered around. Tom Saunders was in that band. And the fellow…
